Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000430": As of 2025-05-15, the pager for webhooks rings the Boreal team instead of the Ember team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000424": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-05-15, when ownership moved from the Ember team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000420": On 2025-05-15, Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher runbook.  (about: Lena, webhook dispatcher, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000412": The Cinder team observed on 2025-05-14 that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher, cache change)
- memory_id "1000401": Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-05-13, until the next rotation.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman)
- memory_id "1000395": The Boreal team noticed on 2025-05-07 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway, dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000388": Marcus has the pager rotation for the Boreal team as of 2025-05-07, taking over from Lena.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000354" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000334": The notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier, client rollout)
- memory_id "1000331" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher, change policy)
- memory_id "1000288": The Dune team owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-03-20.  (about: Dune team, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000236": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory growth and pinged the owners on 2025-02-21.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000224" [decision]: As of 2025-02-21, the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000193": The webhook dispatcher depends on the bus for outbound events, so it is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier depends on the bus for delivery events, so it is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000177" [decision]: The notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000171": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during incident INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000063": The Boreal team owns the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000057": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000011": The Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
Existing entity names: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team, Lena, Oskar, Cinder, cache change, Atlas team, Priya Raman, authentication gateway, dependency bump, Marcus, the bus, notifier, client rollout, change policy, Dune team, reports pipeline, ledger service, INC-2025-004
